authorization_boundary: The authorized replacement and same-pod follow-up are consumed. No further Gate D driver invocation or pod may start without renewed Owner authorization.
failure_sequence: initial detached driver ran as root and failed the non-root host contract before dependency installation
corrected same-pod follow-up completed host preparation but precreated the output root used for lifecycle logging
gate_d_runtime failed before model loading because output roots are non-overwriting by contract

provider.normalization: Prime CLI historical total_cost units divided by 10000; consistent with prior account records

remediation: Keep lifecycle logs in a separate lifecycle directory and never create the model runtime output root before gate_d_runtime; tested in repository after the stop.
